name: Stygian-Crucible
description: Dust finer than flour pools in the low places, swallowing craters to their rims. Nothing has disturbed ancient meteor crater in a million years, and the dust keeps its surface smooth as held breath.
The air carries cold salt and iodine, and sound behaves strangely: footsteps crack loud, then die without echo. At night the temperature drops fast enough to hear the rock tick as it contracts.
Instruments disagree about signal of unknown origin: mass reads one value, inertia another. Probes sent in return transmitting their own launch signals, timestamped hours early.
Survey contracts pay double for reasons nobody writes down. Veterans read the fine print, then read the survivors.
